status: active goal; no accepted learned policy

protocol.noise: Identical pre-generated standard-normal [time,robot,wheel] array for all conditions at each seed; separate action-noise and physical sensor RNGs. Wheel commands tanh(mean+std*noise).
protocol.spin_reference: Constant +/-0.858 deterministic wheel command inspired by the measured circle actor; not a replay of that actor.
protocol.scope: Scripted reference diagnostic of local stochastic reward incentives at already-valid starts. No learned acquisition, following, switching or acceptance claim.

completed_warm_circle_correction.scope: One of four initially-invalid near-circle cases passed; not randomized acquisition or four-task convergence.

protocol.initial_state_equality: all actor parameters except log_std, critic, optimizer, worlds, hidden and Torch/sampling RNGs verified equal; both deterministic action heads initially zero
protocol.hypothesis: Smaller initial exploration noise may reduce the incentive to saturate opposite wheel commands merely to suppress positional diffusion. Paired physics probe shows this local incentive under original rewards; not a claim of the sole cause.
protocol.evaluation: full unchanged 85-episode random/switch suite, five chain-follow episodes, 30 near-formation diagnostics; report initially-valid cases separately
protocol.limits: One training seed, circle-only training, near-start distribution. No accepted actor, no automatic extension/promotion. Both initial sigmas remain trainable. Future entropy/statistics may change them.
protocol.heldout_seeds: reserved and unused in this study
protocol.deployment: same actor shape, deterministic one-step GRU and preprocessing; no new actor inputs or runtime operators

simulation_and_hardware: No sensing/actor/runtime contract changed. Sensor nominal FoV reference is separate from the unconfirmed six-value hardware aggregation.
